english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese word for underpants.
Use this specifically for underpants rather than ordinary outer trousers.

examples.english: Your underpants are torn, so change them quickly.
examples.traditional: 你條底褲爛咗，快啲換啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 tiu4 dai2 fu3 laan6 zo2 faai3 di1 wun6 laa1

examples.english: I changed my pants this morning.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 wun6 zo2 tiu4 dai2 fu3
